guidance.claim: The company expects to improve the quality and yield of gelatine.
guidance.quote: The Company expects to improve the quality and yield of Gelatine.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for gelatin in the nutraceutical and pharmaceutical sectors is driven by growing awareness of its health benefits.
demand_outlook.quote: Gelatin, being a rich source of collagen, is recognised for boosting joint health, skin elasticity, and hair strength, driving its demand in the nutraceutical and pharmaceutical sectors.

demand_outlook.claim: The demand for medicines is expected to increase due to the rapid growth of the ageing population globally.
demand_outlook.quote: Owing to the rapid growth of the ageing population across the world, the demand for medicines is expected to increase.

demand_outlook.claim: Changing lifestyles and an increasing working population are driving the demand for convenience food and beverages, which in turn drives gelatine demand.
demand_outlook.quote: There is also increasing demand for convenience food and beverages due to changing lifestyles, increasing working population as consumers lacks the time to prepare home – cooked food and are more inclined towards convenience food products. These are driving the growth in gelatine demand world over.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is discussing the installation of a 2 MW solar power plant within its factory premises.
capex_expansion.quote: Discussion is on for putting up 2 MW solar power plant with in the factory premises.

margins_costs.claim: Material consumed in fiscal 2023-24 reduced by 1% due to better yield, and power and fuel costs reduced by 1.5% due to improved boiler efficiency and lower coal prices.
margins_costs.quote: Material consumed in fiscal 2023-24 reduced by 1%, which is due to better yield, power and fuel cost reduce by 1.5% due to improvement in boiler's efficiency, which resulted in lower consumption of coal and also due to decrease in the coal prices.

margins_costs.claim: Employee cost stood at 8.21% of revenue from operations.
margins_costs.quote: Employee cost stood at 8.21% (7.17% previous year) of revenue from operations.

margins_costs.claim: Other expenses increased to 6.35% of revenue from operations.
margins_costs.quote: Other expenses were on the higher side at 6.35% as compared to the previous year at 6.23% of revenue from operations.

margins_costs.claim: The average selling price of gelatine increased by 3.28% while DCP decreased by 5% compared to the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: Average selling price of gelatine increased by 3.28% but DCP decreased by 5% as compared to last year.

orders_capacity.claim: Sales volume of gelatine and DCP decreased by 5% and 8% respectively.
orders_capacity.quote: Sales volume of gelatine / DCP decreased by 5%/ 8%.

risks_headwinds.claim: The rise of plant-based gelatin substitutes is a primary market barrier.
risks_headwinds.quote: The rise of plant-based gelatin substitutes, fueled by rising demand for vegetarian and vegan goods, is one of the primary market barriers.

risks_headwinds.claim: Traditional gelatin made from animal sources is threatened by the trend toward sustainable and ethical alternatives.
risks_headwinds.quote: Traditional gelatin made from animal sources is in danger due to this trend, as consumers look for alternatives that take sustainability and ethics into account.

risks_headwinds.claim: Sourcing good quality crushed bones, the main raw material, is a major concern.
risks_headwinds.quote: The availability of our main raw material, i.e. crushed bones, is a cause of concern The difficulty in sourcing good quality raw material is a major issue.

risks_headwinds.claim: Low-cost industrial or technical grade gelatin unfit for human consumption is being imported from China and blended with high-quality Indian gelatin.
risks_headwinds.quote: According to the minutes of the meeting of the Drugs Consultative Committee – there is an increasing evidence that low cost industrial or technical grade gelatin unfit for human consumption is being imported from China, by unscrupulous traders and sold to capsule manufacturers who blend it with high quality gelatin made in India, in the manufacturing of capsules.

risks_headwinds.claim: Cultural and religious prohibitions are impeding market growth.
risks_headwinds.quote: Furthermore, cultural and religious prohibitions are impeding market growth.
